turns.question: Which customer country generated the most non-cancelled order revenue in September 2026, and how much was it in EUR?
turns.answer: Germany (DE) generated the most revenue in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), at 2,665.50 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
